table.name: TLGNR_UOM_BS
table.description: Unit of Measurement, based on the base unit 1 ton / 1 piece / 1 hour specified in UOM_DIMENSION.

column.name: UOM_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data. If the UoM exists in SAP, then it's identical. Some values are used in Logon only.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.

column.name: NUMERATOR_FOR_CONVERSION
column.description: Nullable. Multiplier in respect to the base unit in UOM_DIMENSION_CD. Even for vague units (truck, railcar) a conversion and a uom_dimension is necessary; this is needed to estimate the amount for not-yet-dispatched orders. If null (e.g. at alternative UoM) then the UOM_DIMENSION_CD is also null. In this case the conversion to the base unit in UOM_DIMENSION_CD would be incorrect since the alternative UoM is material specific (global conversion not possible use tlgns_sap_material_alt_uom.numerator_for_conversion for conversion to the base unit of the material)

column.name: DENOMINATOR_FOR_CONVERSION
column.description: Nullable. Divisor in respect to the base unit in UOM_DIMENSION_CD. Even for vague units (truck, railcar) a conversion and a uom_dimension is necessary; this is needed to estimate the amount for not-yet-dispatched orders. If null (e.g. at alternative UoM) then the UOM_DIMENSION_CD is also null. In this case the conversion to the base unit in UOM_DIMENSION_CD would be incorrect since the alternative UoM is material specific (global conversion not possible use tlgns_sap_material_alt_uom.denominator_for_conversion for conversion to the base unit of the material)

column.name: CREATE_MULTI_ORDER_FLAG
column.description: When creating an order and this flag is set, several orders will be created, depending on the order quantity. Example: 3 trucks will create 3 orders (true), but 2 BAGS or 4 TONS will still lead to only one order (false)

column.name: AVAILABLE_IN_WEB_ORDER_FLAG
column.description: 1=unit of measure is shown to the customer when taking an order via web user interface.

column.name: FUZZY_QUANTITY_FLAG
column.description: 1=unit of measure is a so-called 'fuzzy' (or vague) UOM used for ordered_uom_cd. Examples: 1 Truck (LKW) is an UOM used in order taking, and counts as 28 tons until the order is actually dispatched to a real truck (and the net amount will become known by the truck type/loading). 1 Rail-wagon, 1 Container are just as fuzzy, even 1 PAL (because there could be 40 or 48 bags on it).

column.name: UOM_DIMENSION_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_uom_dimension_bs. Nullable. Code of UOM dimension in which UOM_CD is expressed (1 ton, 1 hour, 1 piece). 1 UOM_DIMENSION_CD * NUMERATUR / DENOMINATOR = 1 UOM_CD. If null (e.g. at alternative UoM) then the NUMERATOR_FOR_CONVERSION and DENOMINATOR_FOR_CONVERSION are also null. In this case the conversion to the base unit in UOM_DIMENSION_CD would be incorrect since the alternative UoM is material specific (global conversion not possible use tlgns_sap_material_alt_uom.numerator_for_conversion and denominator_for_conversion for conversion to the base unit of the material)

column.name: SEND_TO_SAP
column.description: Code used by outgoing SAP interfaces. If null, uom_cd is sent to SAP (i.e. no override).
